ez_stock_ticker.gui.title: Ez Stock Ticker
ez_stock_ticker.gui.description: Adds quality of life improvements to the stock ticker UI.
ez_stock_ticker.config.enabled.tooltip: Whether the mod is enabled or not, hope you come back soon!
ez_stock_ticker.config.auto_focus_search: Automatically focuses the search bar when opening a stock keeper
ez_stock_ticker.config.scroll_snapping.t: Whether items should be snapped to increments when scrolling, snapping in different increments when holding Shift or Ctrl
ez_stock_ticker.config.right_click_divid: Right clicking an item in the order bar divides the requested amount by 2
ez_stock_ticker.config.prevent_stack_del: Prevents scrolling from removing an item from the order bar entirely
ez_stock_ticker.config.default_snapping_: The default snapping increment for scrolling. Can be a number or a simple expression starting with 'stack', like 'stack*5', 'stack*0.25', 'stack/4'.
ez_stock_ticker.config.ctrl_snapping_exp: The Ctrl snapping increment for scrolling. Can be a number or a simple expression starting with 'stack', like 'stack*5', 'stack*0.25', 'stack/4'.
ez_stock_ticker.config.shift_snapping_ex: The Shift snapping increment for scrolling. Can be a number or a simple expression starting with 'stack', like 'stack*5', 'stack*0.25', 'stack/4'.
ez_stock_ticker.config.ctrl_shift_snappi: The Ctrl+Shift snapping increment for scrolling. Can be a number or a simple expression starting with 'stack', like 'stack*5', 'stack*0.25', 'stack/4'.
